title: Eritrean man is second to be deported to France under UK’s ‘one in, one out’ deal
summary: Home Office confirms man left Heathrow for Paris early on Friday after losing high court bid to block move An Eritrean man has been deported to France under the UK government’s “one in, one out” deal with the neighbouring country. The man – the second to be deported under the agreement – was on a flight that left Heathrow for Paris at 6.15am on Friday, the Home Office confirmed after he lost a high court attempt to block the move. title: Indonesia Seeks to Review Law That Sets Budget Deficit, Debt Cap
summary: Indonesia’s legislative priorities next year will include a law that sets the limits on the nation’s budget deficit and debt levels, according to a list published by parliament on Friday.
